GOAL: Fit three sliding pieces into yellow outlines. CONTROLS: Arrows slide pieces; Space cycles active piece. RULE: Pieces stop only when hitting walls or other pieces, not targets. TRAP: Believing pieces stop at yellow outlines causes wasted moves; keep sliding until they hit a barrier.

ESTABLISHED: The bubble is five units wide and aligns perfectly with the vertical channel. The room’s ceiling blocks upward exit. The shaft connects the room to the bottom strip. TRAP: Assuming any adjacent position works causes failed pours; precise positioning is required for the liquid to land inside.

GOAL: Cover all remaining yellow cells by positioning the piece and its shadows over them. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected object; Space cycles between the piece, horizontal line, and vertical line. RULE: Yellow disappears only when covered by the object or its mirrored shadows; full coverage clears the cell. TRAP: Assuming one move clears everything wastes time; partial coverage leaves yellow behind, requiring precise multi-step positioning.

GOAL: Guide the pink blob into the upper pool by clearing the water channel below it. CONTROLS: Click plugs to remove blockages; use arrow keys to shift the blob horizontally before releasing it. RULE: The blob only rises vertically through open channels, so align it with a cleared path first. TRAP: Assuming the blob moves upward immediately after removing a plug; it stays put until you press the direction key.

GOAL: Match every tile's pattern to its target by rotating glyphs. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor between tiles; pressing rotates the current tile. RULE: The cursor bracket snaps to the leftmost glyph of the selected tile. TRAP: Assuming wheel rotations are independent per color; they often cycle together, wasting turns.

GOAL: Recolor the plus and position it over four matching blue dots. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the plus one step; space cycled the active shape. RULE: The plus only changed color when its arms touched a swatch of that hue. TRAP: Moving diagonally was impossible; you had to navigate around obstacles using only cardinal steps.

GOAL: Place a shape so its reflections in two mirrors cover all yellow cells exactly. CONTROLS: Arrow keys moved the shape’s position; space confirmed the placement. RULE: Reflections are clipped by the mirror strips themselves, so parts of the shape touching the mirrors do not reflect. TRAP: Assuming reflections pass through the mirror strips led to over-covering the center and failing the level.

GOAL: Reach the exit while dodging four bouncing hazards. CONTROLS: Arrows move you; idle waits are free. RULE: Hazards move only when you do, so time your steps carefully. TRAP: Assuming idle actions advance hazards wastes turns; they stay still until you move.

GOAL: Place the L-piece and line segment onto matching yellow target zones. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected piece; Space cycles to the next piece. RULE: Pieces must align perfectly with the hidden grid to snap into place. TRAP: Assuming pieces are already aligned because they look close; precise arrow presses are required to reach the exact target coordinates.

GOAL: Move yellow blocks into place using a six-step sequence. CONTROLS: Left and right arrows shift columns; top arrows rotate the grid. RULE: Green arrows reverse the previous move, allowing precise backtracking. TRAP: Assuming all moves are permanent wastes time; remember that undoing is often the fastest path forward.

GOAL: Guide two yellow blocks into the matching top-row brackets. CONTROLS: Top buttons rotate only the five top cells; side buttons rotate the full twenty-one-cell loop. RULE: Side moves shift blocks along the main path; top moves adjust position once a block reaches the shared top row. TRAP: Assuming top and side buttons affect independent groups; they actually share the top five cells, so order matters critically.

GOAL: Align two separate pieces to the right and lower the horizontal line to complete the pattern. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the currently selected object; clicking selects a different object or line. RULE: Only the selected object responds to arrow keys, requiring precise selection before movement. TRAP: Clicking an already selected object registers as an action but causes no visible change, wasting moves.

GOAL: Place the two falling pieces onto their matching yellow target shapes before they stack too high. CONTROLS: Arrows slide the active piece; Space locks it in place. RULE: Pieces only move in the direction of gravity until locked; horizontal shifts stop at obstacles. TRAP: Assuming the piece stays in column alignment after moving up; you must manually shift it left to hit the target.

GOAL: Navigate a grid past moving hazards and saws to reach the exit. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move your character one space per step. RULE: Hazards move predictably on fixed paths; timing your arrival to avoid their positions is key. TRAP: Assuming a hazard stops at a wall when it might actually pass through or bounce differently, leading to fatal timing errors.

GOAL: Align the movable piece with its reflection to cover the yellow zone. CONTROLS: Arrows shift selected objects; clicks select pieces or grid lines. RULE: Objects mirror across grid lines, so align lines first to fix reflection paths. TRAP: Moving the piece before positioning lines causes misalignment and wasted turns.

GOAL: Move three shapes to paint their matching color zones. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active shape; Space switches to the next shape. RULE: A shape paints only when its edge touches the target zone. TRAP: Moving directly up blocked by hidden walls; shift sideways first to clear the path.

GOAL: Reach the exit while avoiding the moving saw in column 4. CONTROLS: Arrows move the player one cell up, down, left, or right. RULE: The saw moves down column 4 every turn, occupying a new cell each time. TRAP: Assuming the saw stays still when you are far away; it moves regardless of your position.

GOAL: Place two shapes to cover colored dots using specific color rules. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected shape; Space switches between the X and Plus. RULE: Shapes only change color when their tips touch a legend square, not just any overlap. TRAP: Moving the Plus blindly wastes actions; it must touch the legend to turn orange before covering the dots.

GOAL: Rotate star arms to move yellow blocks into the center brackets. CONTROLS: Click star buttons to rotate arms; click center button to snap blocks. RULE: Star rotations move blocks along tracks; center button locks aligned blocks. TRAP: Rotating stars before aligning blocks in the center causes misplacement.

GOAL: Paint the bottom-left corner white while keeping the upper-right orange. CONTROLS: Arrows rotate the cup’s position around the central block; clicks select ink colors; space pours the current ink. RULE: The cup pours only into cells directly facing its opening, allowing precise sector-by-sector coloring. TRAP: Assuming arrow keys move the cup linearly across the grid rather than rotating it around the center.

GOAL: Clear the narrow neck by opening the clamps. CONTROLS: Arrows move the block; clicks light panel cells. RULE: Lighting the matching pattern releases the clamps, widening the path. TRAP: You cannot force a 4x4 block through while clamps are active; you must trigger the release mechanism first.

GOAL: Move yellow token to target slot using minimal clicks. CONTROLS: Arrows rotate specific row or column cycles. RULE: Arrows shift all items in a line one step, wrapping around ends. TRAP: Assuming arrows swap only two items; they actually rotate the whole line, so one click moves every piece in that row or column.

GOAL: Click tiles to flip them and their neighbors, turning all target cells to the desired color while ignoring unconstrained cells. CONTROLS: Click a tile to toggle it and its orthogonal neighbors. RULE: The grid behaves like a symmetric matrix, so solving the system is consistent regardless of direction. TRAP: Assuming every cell has a fixed target color; some cells are unconstrained and can be either color.

GOAL: Move each numbered tile to its matching target pattern using the fewest arrow keys. CONTROLS: Arrow keys slide the active tile; the game auto-selects the next target in sequence. RULE: Tiles must land exactly on the ghost outline; overlapping is forbidden and blocks movement. TRAP: Trying to align all tiles simultaneously wastes turns; solve them one by one in strict order.

GOAL: Clear the red blockers to open a path to the head. CONTROLS: Arrows move the tip; the surge action burns obstacles. RULE: Surges convert broken red segments into safe gray cable. TRAP: Thinking the pink socket was a target to hit rather than an obstacle to clear.

GOAL: Paint the grid to match the target pattern using ink pours. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the cup; clicking an ink box selects color; SPACE pours; clicking the vessel applies the current color to a specific region. RULE: A pour fills all connected empty cells that satisfy the active color’s numeric constraint. TRAP: Believing a pour stops at color boundaries; it ignores existing colors, filling all valid empty cells in the connected area.

GOAL: Move the X, D, and P shapes to cover dots of matching colors. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active shape; Space switches to the next shape in the cycle. RULE: A shape takes the color of the last zone it touches. TRAP: Thinking the cycle order is random; it is fixed, so skip checking after every switch to save time.

ESTABLISHED: Saws track your current position along their axis only when you are within their line of sight. Leaving that line stops their movement immediately. FAILED: Assuming saws chase you indefinitely once activated, or that they ignore distance when tracking. GOAL IS NOT: Simply reaching the exit while ignoring saw timing; you cannot outrun them once engaged. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move one step. Watch saw positions closely; do not enter their line unless you plan to exit it instantly.

GOAL: Solve the puzzle in nine clicks. CONTROLS: Clicking grid points shifts color blocks horizontally or vertically. RULE: Red markers shift blocks one direction; green markers shift them the opposite way. TRAP: Assuming shift direction depends on click order rather than marker color wastes time.

GOAL: Seat two crosses and a green block into matching charcoal outlines. CONTROLS: Arrows slide the green block; pushing it against a floating cross launches that cross fifteen cells in the opposite direction. RULE: Crosses fly fixed distances when bumped, so position the green block precisely to trigger each launch. TRAP: Assuming crosses move freely with arrows wastes turns; they only move when pushed by the green block.

GOAL: Reach the exit before the orange orb crushes you. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move one step; the orb moves simultaneously. RULE: The orb patrols a fixed path; time your moves to slip through gaps as it leaves. TRAP: Thinking you can pass while the orb is moving; you must wait until it has fully exited the cell.

GOAL: Make two specific slots yellow. CONTROLS: Top buttons rotate a small 5-slot ring; side buttons rotate a long 21-slot path. RULE: Each click shifts colors one step; opposite buttons undo the move. TRAP: Assuming all slots move together; the rings are separate, so you must align them independently.

GOAL: Clear the board by matching patterns in just six moves. CONTROLS: Arrow keys shift the grid; observe how symbols wrap and overlap. RULE: Only the unique silhouette of the shape matters, not its orientation or position. TRAP: Assuming fixed coordinates or specific symbol colors are essential, rather than recognizing that rotation and translation are irrelevant to the match.

GOAL: Rotate a cup to pour three colors onto a block, matching a specific pattern of orange, purple, and blue sections. CONTROLS: Arrow keys rotate the cup's orientation; clicking a color selects it; Spacebar pours the selected color from the cup. RULE: The ink drop always spreads perpendicular to the pour direction, centered on the block, with width determined by the vessel's size. TRAP: Assuming the drop aligns with the cup's exact edge; it actually centers on the block's face, requiring precise rotation for correct placement.

GOAL: Move a red drop from the top to the bottom by pouring colored liquids into specific triangular zones. CONTROLS: Arrow keys rotate the ring of slots to position the vessel; clicks select liquids; space pours the selected liquid. RULE: The ring has eight slots arranged clockwise, so moving between opposite sides requires multiple steps. TRAP: Assuming the drop falls immediately after pouring; it only falls when you click the small vessel at the north position.

GOAL: Guide the player to the exit tile while avoiding moving hazards. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one step in the chosen direction. RULE: Hazards follow a fixed, repeating path independent of player movement. TRAP: Assuming hazards pause or change speed when you stand still; they always advance.

GOAL: Arrange pieces to spell the target word by merging two boxes. CONTROLS: Drag pieces to slots; spacebar confirms the solution. RULE: The connector piece inserts the green box sequence into the red box at its position. TRAP: Assuming slots are independent; the connector actually splices the green sequence into the red reading order.

GOAL: Arrange pieces to form a specific nine-item sequence. CONTROLS: Click tray items to place them into red or blue slots, then press space to test. RULE: Blue slots output their contents twice, creating a repeating three-item pattern within the final sequence. TRAP: Assuming blue items appear only once wastes time; identify the repeated triplet in the target list to deduce the blue box contents immediately.

GOAL: Arrange colored mouths to dictate the sequence of letter triples matching the target list. CONTROLS: Click mouths to place them in red slots, click letters to fill corresponding colored boxes, and press space to submit. RULE: Each mouth’s color links it to a specific box, so their order in the red slots defines the final letter sequence. TRAP: Assuming boxes fill independently ignores that mouth placement strictly determines the output order, causing mismatched triples.

GOAL: Guide the token to the yellow island. CONTROLS: Arrows move the token; clicking icons rotates bars. RULE: Standing on a glyph unlocks its matching control. TRAP: Rotating bars before reaching the pivot blocks your path.

GOAL: Nest three colored boxes so their mouths align, filling a specific pattern of colors across seven slots. CONTROLS: Click pieces to place them into box slots; use SPACE to confirm the final arrangement. RULE: The middle slot must be the unique highlight, forcing the mouth placements to center each nested box. TRAP: Assuming the outer boxes determine the sequence first; the innermost green box dictates the entire nested structure.

GOAL: Guide three markers into the central bracket slots. CONTROLS: Click star arms to rotate markers; click the center to cycle them through slots. RULE: Outer arm clicks shift a marker one step along its star’s path toward the center. TRAP: Assuming clicking the center moves markers freely; it only cycles those already inside the central ring.

GOAL: Move three distinct blocks into two large balls without overlapping their boundaries prematurely. CONTROLS: Click a destination to slide a block; merge blocks by clicking a shared target; use off-grid clicks to nudge final positions. RULE: A block only counts when fully inside a ball; intermediate stops must stay strictly outside the ball’s edge. TRAP: Thinking merged blocks stay at the click point; they actually settle at the mover’s original target, requiring extra adjustment.

GOAL: Pour liquid from the cup into the block by sliding until it hits the boundary. CONTROLS: Click to rotate the cup’s opening direction; space to pour the liquid. RULE: Liquid flows only into cells within the diagonal limit row plus column equals seventy. TRAP: Assuming the cup stops at the block’s surface; it actually slides until the liquid’s edge aligns with the limit.

GOAL: Fill two specific sockets with yellow blocks. CONTROLS: Click side plugs to shift the horizontal row; click top plugs to cycle the vertical column. RULE: The row and column share a single cell, so moving one group inevitably disturbs the shared cell's color. TRAP: Assuming the vertical section was a simple two-cell swap instead of a three-cell cycle caused a parity mismatch that required extra clicks to resolve.

GOAL: Merge a small piece with a large blob, then deliver the combined piece to a distant target zone. CONTROLS: Click to move a piece; clicks adjust both row and column simultaneously based on piece size. RULE: Pieces merge only if their Manhattan distance is eleven or less. TRAP: Assuming larger pieces move faster per click; movement speed depends on size, but distance thresholds for merging remain strict.

GOAL: Clear the board by destroying red blocks using perpendicular approaches. CONTROLS: Arrows move two squares; land on blocks from side or top to break them. RULE: You cannot land on a danger zone; approach blocks only from directions their faces do not point. TRAP: Assuming any adjacent move works; hitting a block head-on or from behind triggers its lunge and fails the level.

GOAL: Move the plug between three ends and their targets to route both colored assemblies correctly. CONTROLS: Clicking a cable end transfers the plug; clicking a target moves that end. RULE: The plug must be transferred to an end before that end can be moved. TRAP: Believing the plug stays on the current assembly prevents moving other ends, causing wasted actions.

GOAL: The puzzle required stamping a specific color pattern onto a grid using a movable tool. TRAP: Assuming the stamp color applied globally instead of just the masked area caused unnecessary moves to fix errors.

GOAL: Reach the exit while avoiding the chaser. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move one step. RULE: The chaser always moves toward your current position, making its path predictable if you keep moving. TRAP: Believing you could stop to rest; pausing allows the chaser to corner you, forcing continuous movement to stay safe.

GOAL: Split the square into four distinct colored regions using two pour actions. CONTROLS: Click swatches to select paint; press space to pour; click plunger to stamp. RULE: Pour masks only fill the open side of the cup, ignoring blocked areas. TRAP: Assuming the plunger stays fixed; it moves with the cup, requiring you to locate its new position before stamping.

GOAL: Place two purple beads so their combined position matches the target sum. CONTROLS: Click a bead to select it, then click a valid spot to move it. RULE: The final two bead positions must add up to the required coordinate total. TRAP: Ignoring that beads cannot overlap or sit too close to existing green pieces.

GOAL: Fill the grid with correct colors using two pours and one stamp. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the cup; click color to load; spacebar pours; click plunger to stamp. RULE: Pouring fills cells matching the station’s geometric mask, overriding previous colors in that area. TRAP: Thinking you must move to the exact target location before pouring; instead, pour from a station whose mask covers the entire needed region.

GOAL: Guide two mirrored balls to collide and merge into one shape. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move both balls simultaneously, but left and right inputs reverse for the second ball. RULE: The level ends only after the merged blob moves one final step away from the collision point. TRAP: Believing the merge itself finishes the level wastes time waiting for a signal that requires an extra move.

GOAL: Rotate the red pillar to form a bridge, then climb to the core. CONTROLS: Arrows move the green square; clicking a red podium rotates it. RULE: Rotated pillars become solid walkable surfaces, allowing vertical ascent. TRAP: Assuming the health bar drains one unit per action; it drains slowly, so you have ample moves.

GOAL: Move a glowing token along a star-shaped track to reach the target. CONTROLS: Click the left arrow to move inward; click the right arrow to move outward. RULE: Each click shifts the token one ring, but the ring wraps around after the outer edge. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the piece; clicks rotated it to align reflections with the grid. RULE: Only the mirrored reflections count towards covering the yellow; the piece itself must not overlap the target. TRAP: Assuming the piece could sit inside the yellow area, which blocked the win condition despite full visual coverage.

GOAL: Move two blocks to separate targets while guiding a marker to a specific spot. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the selected block or marker; clicking switches selection between them.
